content: God Nawu Yawey Benngehkeng Bininj Nuye Kore Egyptbeh.
Bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng birribolkbawong kore kunred Egypt. Bedda nawu Jacob nuye namud wanjh birribebmeng, dja bindibawong kunred bedberre bininj nawu birridjenbuyika.

Bedda wanjh Judah nuye mawahmawah. Bu bedda birribolkbawong Egypt wanjh birriyimerranj bu djal God nuye bininj. Bedda nawu Israel nuye mawahmawah wanjh birriyimerranj bininj kore djal God kabenmarnewohrnawohrnan.
Bu kunmekbe bolkyimi, wanjh kurrula bikurdunang Yawey dja kelerlobmeng! Dja mak mankabo Jordan borledmerrinj dja wohdurnderrinj kore borlobmirlobmi.
Dja mak manbu kuwarddekimuk rowk bolkdorrolkang, yiman kayime mayh nawu sheep karrohdolkan!
Ngudda nawu kurrula, njalekenh yikelerlobmeng? Dja ngudda mankabo Jordan, njalekenh yikebrokborledkerrinj?
Ngudda manbu kuwarddekimuk, njalekenh ngudda yibolkdoldolkang yiman nawu mayh?
Mah, ngudda nawu kurorre kore kubolkwarlahkenh rowk, wanjh ngurribolkdeldelmen dja nawu Kawohrnan Rowk kahdi darnkih! Nungka nawu Jacob nuye God!
Nungka bolkmarnbom dja bolkbuyikawong manbu kunwardde bu bolkyimerranj manlabbarl! Manwardderayek wanjh nungka marnbom yimerranj kungad kore kukku kambobebme!
